vulnerability.explanation: fprintf uses "%lu" to print xd->xd_example_single (uint32_t). On LP64 platforms where unsigned long is 64-bit, this varargs type mismatch causes fprintf to read 8 bytes from the stack while only 4 were provided, leading to an out-of-bounds stack read and potential information leak or crash.
